_comment: Uptime probe as a Railway CRON service — the second, independent scheduler.
Why: our only uptime monitoring used to run on GitHub Actions, which stops
silently when Actions billing fails (observed 2026-07-25). Running the same
probe from Railway means one provider's billing cannot blind us completely.
A cron service runs the start command on schedule and exits — it is NOT a
long-running server, so it has no healthcheckPath and must not restart on
exit. A non-zero exit (endpoints down) is the expected failure signal and
must not trigger a restart loop, hence restartPolicyType NEVER.
This service intentionally reuses api/Dockerfile.railway so it needs no new
build config; it only runs a stdlib-only script.
Required variables on this service: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN,
PROBE_SOURCE is set below so the dead-man's switch can tell the two
